integrity: The general formula follows from group-action fixed-point identities and Burnside orbit counting; small-degree enumeration is independent corroboration and not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary (1,1) polynomial is determined. The result does not count link colorings or higher-iterate polynomial invariants. The partition asymptotic is classical; finite direct checks extend only through degree five. An equivalent unindexed matrix-rack treatment is a residual literature risk.
title: Quandle polynomial and fixed-pair census of universal Cayley quandles
